title: 借书冠军与不是白色的北极熊
pdf: https://michael-podcast-1513696684.cos.ap-chengdu.myqcloud.com/vol40/Vol40_晚读讲义_借书冠军与不是白色的北极熊_v1.pdf
pdfName: Vol40_晚读讲义_借书冠军与不是白色的北极熊_v1.pdf

blocks.en: Hello, young explorers, and welcome back to Michael's Morning Listening! Today we have two surprises for you: a boy who borrowed more books than any other young reader in his state, and a bear that looks white but is not white at all. Ready? Let's go!
blocks.title: 开场白
blocks.cn: 你好，小小探险家们，欢迎回到 Michael 的早听晚读！今天有两个惊喜等着你们：一位是借书比本州其他小读者都多的男孩，还有一只看起来白、其实一点也不白的熊。准备好了吗？出发！

blocks.en: In Malaysia, there is a boy named Alif. He is thirteen years old, and he loves books more than anything. His little public library is just a short walk from his house, and Alif calls it his second home. Reading has built a strong bond between Alif and his little library.
blocks.title: 借书冠军小读者
blocks.cn: 在马来西亚，有个叫阿利夫的男孩。他十三岁，爱书胜过一切。他家附近的小公共图书馆离他家只有几步路，阿利夫把它叫做自己的第二个家。读书在他和这座小图书馆之间搭起了一座坚固的纽带。

blocks.en: After school, Alif takes a short rest, and then he reads. At night, after his homework is done, he reads again. Book by book, the numbers accumulated: in one year, Alif borrowed 1,378 books from the library! That is more than three books every day.
blocks.title: 借书冠军小读者
blocks.cn: 放学后，阿利夫先休息一会儿，然后就开始读书。到了晚上，做完作业，他又接着读。一本接一本，数字越积越多：一年里，阿利夫从图书馆借了 1,378 本书！平均每天超过三本。

blocks.en: Soon the library's statistics told an amazing story: no other young reader in the whole state had borrowed so many books. The librarians approved a special prize for him, and they named him the top young borrower of the year.
blocks.title: 借书冠军小读者
blocks.cn: 很快，图书馆的统计数字讲出了一个惊人的故事：全州没有别的小读者借过这么多书。图书管理员们批准给他一份特别奖励，并称他为本年度借书冠军小读者。

blocks.en: Alif reads real paper books, not screens. He says it is easier to understand a paper book, and easier to share what he learns with others. When he grows up, he wants to be a science teacher. Meanwhile, his love of reading is already teaching everyone around him one simple lesson: a small library card can open a big world.
blocks.title: 借书冠军小读者
blocks.cn: 阿利夫读的是真正的纸质书，不是屏幕。他说纸质书更容易读懂，也更容易把学到的东西分享给别人。长大后，他想当一名科学老师。同时，他对阅读的热爱已经在教周围所有人一个简单的道理：一张小小的借书卡，可以打开一个大大的世界。

blocks.en: Now, from a warm library in Malaysia, let's travel far north, to the frozen Arctic. There lives the polar bear, the great white bear of the ice. But here is a secret: the polar bear is not white at all!
blocks.title: 不是白色的北极熊
blocks.cn: 现在，让我们从马来西亚温暖的图书馆出发，一路向北，来到冰封的北极。那里生活着北极熊——冰原上伟大的白熊。但有个秘密：北极熊其实一点也不白！

blocks.en: Look closely at one hair of its coat. It is not white. It is transparent, like a tiny glass tube, and it is hollow inside. The hair has no white color in it at all. So why does the bear look white? Because sunlight bounces around inside all those tiny clear tubes, and the light that comes back to our eyes looks white. It is a trick of the light!
blocks.title: 不是白色的北极熊
blocks.cn: 仔细看它皮毛上的一根毛。它不是白色的。它是透明的，像一根细细的玻璃管，而且里面是空心的。这根毛里根本没有白色。那么熊为什么看起来是白的呢？因为阳光在所有这些细小的透明管子里来回反弹，回到我们眼睛里的光看起来就是白色的。这就是光线变的小魔术！

blocks.en: Under all that clear hair, the bear's skin is black. Black skin is good at soaking up the sun's warmth. And under the skin there is a thick layer of fat. Together, the clear coat, the black skin, and the fat work like a warm winter jacket: even in freezing wind, very little warmth leaks out.
blocks.title: 不是白色的北极熊
blocks.cn: 在所有这些透明毛发下面，熊的皮肤是黑色的。黑皮肤很擅长吸收太阳的热量。而皮肤下面还有一层厚厚的脂肪。透明的毛、黑色的皮肤和脂肪一起，就像一件暖和的冬衣：即使在刺骨的寒风里，也只有极少的热量会漏出去。

blocks.en: The white look is also perfect camouflage. On the ice, a white bear is almost invisible, so seals do not see it coming. But the bear's real colors are a surprise: clear hair, black skin, and a clever design that keeps it alive in one of the coldest places on Earth.
blocks.title: 不是白色的北极熊
blocks.cn: 白色的外表还是完美的伪装。在冰面上，一只白熊几乎看不见，海豹也就发现不了它靠近。但熊真实的颜色却让人惊讶：透明的毛、黑色的皮肤，还有一套精巧的设计，让它能在地球上最冷的地方之一活下来。

blocks.en: Here's today's idiom: 'walking on air.' When you are walking on air, you are so happy that you feel like you are floating! Here's an example: 'When Alif heard he was the top young borrower, he was walking on air all the way home!' Have you ever felt like you were walking on air?
blocks.title: 今日俚语
blocks.cn: 今天的俚语是“walking on air”（在空中行走）。当你 walking on air 时，你高兴得感觉自己像飘起来了一样！举个例子：“当阿利夫听说自己是借书冠军小读者时，他一路走回家都像飘在空中！”你有没有过像飘在空中一样高兴的时候？

blocks.en: Let's think about our stories: a boy who read 1,378 books, and a bear that looks white but is not. First: if you could borrow any three books from the library today, which three would you pick? Second: the polar bear's coat is a trick of the light — what other animal tricks can you think of? Talk about it with your family!
blocks.title: 结束语与互动问题
blocks.cn: 我们来想想今天的故事：一个读了 1,378 本书的男孩，和一只看起来白、其实不白的熊。第一：如果你今天能从图书馆借任意三本书，你会选哪三本？第二：北极熊的毛色是光线变的小魔术——你还能想到哪些动物的奇妙把戏？和家人聊聊吧！

blocks.en: That's all for today, young explorers. Keep reading, keep wondering, and may you always feel like you are walking on air! See you tomorrow!
blocks.title: 告别
blocks.cn: 今天的节目就到这里啦，小小探险家们。坚持阅读，保持好奇，愿你永远都有像飘在空中一样高兴的时候！明天见！

children.text: Because sunlight bounces around inside all those tiny clear tubes, and the light that comes back to our eyes looks white.
：Because（因为）+ 一整句话，放在句首说明整件事的原因——熊看起来白，是因为阳光在透明管子里反弹。英语里 because 从句可以前置，主句在后，中间用逗号隔开。
that comes back to our eyes
：that（……的）+ 动词短语，紧跟在 light（光）后面，告诉你是哪一道光——就是那道回到我们眼睛里的光。相当于 "the light which comes back to our eyes"，that 在这里指代光。
：and 把两个分句连起来——阳光反弹、光看起来白，两个动作一前一后，原因和结果一次说清。
原因（阳光反弹）→ 限定（回到眼睛的那道光）→ 结果（看起来白）
。一句话里藏着原因状语从句、定语从句和并列结构三个机关。
"in one year, Alif borrowed 1,378 books from the library!"
"Sunlight bounces around inside all those tiny clear tubes, and the light that comes back to our eyes looks white."
"When you are walking on air, you are so happy that you feel like you are floating!"
"When he grows up, he wants to be a science teacher."
D. Your own translations — there is no key for this part. Read your Chinese aloud and check that it sounds natural.
